id.instruksi: Lihat bentuk buah atau bijinya, lalu taruh di cara biji itu tersebar.
id.i-meranti: biji meranti bersayap, berputar saat jatuh
id.i-jarum: biji rumput jarum berkait, menempel di bulu kambing
id.i-tupai: biji kenari disimpan tupai di tanah lalu terlupa
id.i-ketapang: buah ketapang berongga udara, mengapung di laut
id.i-pandan: buah pandan laut mengapung terbawa ombak
id.i-nyamplung: buah nyamplung bulat mengapung di sungai
id.i-keben: buah keben (butun) bergabus, mengapung di laut
id.i-pletekan: buah pletekan pecah sendiri dan melontarkan biji
id.i-jarak: buah jarak kering pecah dan melontarkan biji
id.i-lamtoro: polong lamtoro kering terbelah dan memuntir

en.instruksi: Look at the shape of the fruit or seed, then put it with the way it spreads.
en.i-meranti: winged meranti seed that spins as it falls
en.i-anggrek: orchid seeds as fine as dust
en.i-ilalang: cogon grass seed with fine white hairs
en.i-tabebuya: flat trumpet-tree seed with thin wings
en.i-beringin: small banyan fruit eaten by birds
en.i-kopi: red coffee cherry eaten by a civet
en.i-jarum: hooked beggar-tick seed that sticks to goat fur
en.i-tupai: nut buried by a squirrel and then forgotten
en.i-ketapang: sea almond fruit with air pockets, floating at sea
en.i-pandan: screwpine fruit floating on the waves
en.i-nyamplung: round Alexandrian laurel fruit floating down a river
en.i-keben: corky keben (sea poison tree) fruit floating on the sea
en.i-pletekan: popping-pod fruit that bursts by itself and flings its seeds
en.i-jarak: dry castor fruit that splits and shoots out seeds
en.i-lamtoro: dry leucaena pod that splits and twists open
